audience: workforce and HR teams with enabled Arcoro or ExakTime API access

useCases.title: Review recorded time
useCases.text: Read time records, punches and shifts to investigate a selected period.

useCases.title: Find workforce details
useCases.text: List employees and departments, then inspect a selected employee within the API key permissions.

useCases.title: Review time off
useCases.text: Read time-off requests and balances alongside the relevant pay periods.

useCases.title: Maintain job and cost-code records
useCases.text: Review jobs and cost codes, then create a job or update a cost code when requested. These tools change reference records.
